units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 4:10">Targ. O. Gen. IV, 10</cite>. Targ. ib. IX, 6; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58b:2">B. Bath. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>בריש כל מרעין אנא ד׳ וכ׳</he> at the head of all diseases (chief cause of physical disorders) am I, the blood.

<cite ref="Yoma 82b:1">Yoma 82ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מאי חזית דד׳ דידך וכ׳</he> what right hast thou to assume that thy blood is redder than thy neighbor’s (you have no right to commit murder even under compulsion).
Kidd. 81ᵃ נשויתיה (שויתי) לָדָמָךְ וכ׳ I should have valued thy life two M’ah, i.e. I should not have spared thee; Pes. 112ᵇ Ms. M. (ed. סכנתיך, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200, a. note 3).

<cite ref="Ketubot 60b:15">Keth. 60ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>על דמא דחמרא</he> Ar. s. v. <he>גרדן</he> (ed. <cite ref="T00783"><he>רמא</he></cite>) on the blood of an ass.—Pl. <cite ref="D00892"><he>דְּמֶי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 4:11">Targ. Gen. IV, 11</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:12">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 22a:13">Bets. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ דמעתא וכ׳</he> congestion of the eye, tears &c.
Gitt. 68ᵇ לד׳ דרישא for congestion of the head (head-ache). [דְּמֵי equivalent, v. דָּמִין.] V. אִדְמָא.
